title: helictotrichon montanum subsp. planifolium
intro: Helictotrichon montanum subsp. planifolium, commonly known as Mountain Hakone Grass or Mountain Oat Grass, is a perennial grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to support respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Helictotrichon montanum subsp. planifolium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. Additionally, the plant's bioactive compounds have been reported to have a soothing effect on the skin, making it a potential ingredient in skincare products.
